title: leonurus sibiricus f. albiflorus
intro: Leonurus sibiricus f. albiflorus, commonly known as White-leaved motherwort or Albiflorus motherwort, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include alleviating symptoms of anxiety, insomnia, and stress, as well as providing relief from menstrual cramps and other women's health issues. The therapeutic actions of Leonurus sibiricus f. albiflorus include sedative, anti-anxiety, and anti-spasmodic effects, which are attributed to its ability to relax the nervous system and reduce muscle tension. The bioactive constituents of this plant include iridoid glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
